applicabilityBasis.summary: WEUSD is marketed for payments and RWA settlement, but the documented mint/redeem mechanism exchanges WEUSD for USDC, a digital asset, rather than proving a legal issuer obligation to redeem in national currency or a deposit. GENIUS section 2(22) expressly excludes digital-asset-denominated value from that redemption element. The legal issuer and any separate fiat claim are undisclosed, making applicability genuinely unclear rather than a definitive payment-stablecoin finding.

genius.notes: PicWe's public WEUSD page states 100% USDC backing and future RWA plans; reserveDisclosurePresent records the existence of that issuer composition statement only, not independently verified reserves, segregation or a monthly attestation. A crypto-redemption policy is present: the dedicated Mint & Redeem page specifies 100 WEUSD -> 99 USDC after a 1% fee, while the FAQ says 1:1 redemption and no protocol fees. This internal conflict is unresolved and replaces the former unconditional 1:1 redemption wording. No fiat-redemption obligation or exact legal issuer is identified, so applicability is corrected to unclear; no issuerEntity/domicile/regulator is invented. No public PPSI approval, state qualification, official application, foreign registration or GENIUS enforcement action was located in the opened official sources and exact-name searches. Foreign status stays unknown. Not-yet-restricted is only the pre-effective timing posture. The inaccessible OCC applicant table is not claimed checked. Independent verification on 2026-10-07 reopened every retained reference URL. The statutory applicability analysis is an editorial assessment rather than a regulator ruling. PicWe Wallet terms identify Copariot Labs as wallet-service provider and disclaim transaction counterparty status; these terms do not establish Copariot Labs as WEUSD issuer.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07 no public token-specific GENIUS approval, state-qualified approval, official application or foreign registration for WEUSD or a legally identified PicWe issuer was located in the opened official materials and bounded exact-name searches. Legal issuer identity and fiat redemption remain unresolved; documented USDC redemption is not itself the statutory monetary-value obligation. No public token-specific GENIUS action was found; this is not a guarantee of legality.
